# What is the most you can bid on this pallet?

> Free liquidation pallet bid calculator. Paste a manifest to get the maximum bid for a chance of loss you accept, with a Monte Carlo simulation of recovery rate, sell-through and damage, break-even recovery and concentration risk. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
